description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'ProjectServiceException' within the OrangeHRM's Time plugin. The class provides static methods to generate specific exception instances related to project activity management, such as existence, duplication, and not found errors.

classes.name: ProjectServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for project-related errors within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, providing static methods for common exception scenarios.

methods.name: projectActivityExist
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that project activities with logged time cannot be deleted.

methods.name: duplicateProjectActivityNameFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating a duplicate project activity name was found.

methods.name: projectActivityNotFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating a project activity could not be located.
